changelog:
### Discord Companion 2.8.1 — New Interface

- **A refined dark design system.** The dashboard now has real depth: a five-step elevation ramp, hairline dividers, a proper type scale and a calmer palette. Cards sit on a floating content panel over a subtle blurple/emerald ambient glow instead of flat on the canvas.
- **Polished shell.** The title bar groups its controls, uses uppercase section labels, and keeps a consistent 28px rhythm across the status pill, action buttons and window controls. The sidebar is darker with taller nav items and a soft shadow on the active row.
- **Bento cards that respond.** The overview cards are frosted glass with stronger hover borders, a subtle lift, avatar scale on hover and a short slide-in fade when content arrives. All motion is calm and short — nothing bounces while you are reading.
- **Everything from 2.8.0 is here.** The desktop window (no more browser tab), presence reconciled against READY, resolved guild and DM names, truthful Last Seen, Spotify and voice counters that match the lists, and icon A on the installer, `.exe`, taskbar, tray and browser tab.
- **Local-only, as always.** No new hosts, no telemetry, no AI endpoints. The token stays in the daemon; the catalog, inbox and session history stay in SQLite.
- **Also in this release:** the universal macOS `.dmg` is rebuilt on the same version, and the Windows setup, portable zip, shell, daemon and macOS image are all minisign-signed with the pinned key.

broadcast.title: Discord Companion v2.8.1 is Live!
broadcast.message: A refined dark design system: floating content panel over an ambient glow, glass bento cards with hover lift, a tighter title bar and calmer motion. All the 2.8.0 fixes ride along. Everything stays local.
